candidates.change_summary: Replace `_transferOwnership(newOwner);` with no operation (delete the statement) to leave old owner unchanged.
Replace `_transferOwnership(newOwner);` with `_transferOwnership(address(0));` to set owner to zero address instead of newOwner.
Remove the `onlyOwner` modifier so anyone can call `transferOwnership` and change the owner.
Change `_checkOwner()` to revert unconditionally by replacing with `require(false)`, making `onlyOwner` modifier always fail.
Change `_checkOwner()` to a no-op by deleting the require statement, allowing anyone to pass the `onlyOwner` modifier.
Replace the assignment to rewardDistributor with assignment to address(0) so the distributor is never updated.
Remove the assignment to rewardDistributor so it retains its previous value.
Replace the assignment with rewardDistributor = owner() so it is always set to the current owner regardless of argument.
Delete the onlyOwner modifier on setRewardDistributor so anyone can call it.
Delete the require statement in onlyOwner so the modifier always passes.
